svg.title: Where the numbers come from: rollups, on-demand SQL, client calculations
svg.desc: Where the numbers come from: rollups, on-demand SQL, client calculations. 11 components in 3 groups. Connections: Workspace pages to TanStack Query hooks (query); Workspace pages to lib/finance calculators (compute client-side); TanStack Query hooks to Dashboard metrics API (GET /api/dashboard-metrics/*); TanStack Query hooks to Analytics v2 API (GET /api/analytics/v2/*, POST refresh); TanStack Query hooks to Calculations API (GET /api/calculations/*); TanStack Query hooks to Transactions API (GET /api/transactions/all); TanStack Query hooks to Upload service (POST /api/upload); Dashboard metrics API to transactions (ledger rows, balances); Analytics v2 API to Rollup tables (read); Analytics v2 API to transactions (data health, spending rule); Calculations API to transactions (aggregate); Calculations API to Rollup tables (unfiltered fast path); Transactions API to transactions (full ledger); Upload service to transactions (import rows); Upload service to Analytics engine (after commit); Analytics v2 API to Analytics engine (POST refresh); Analytics engine to transactions (read ledger); Analytics engine to Rollup tables (publish).

text.tspan: WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM: ROLLUPS, ON-DEMAND SQL, CLIENT CALCULATIONS
Rollup tables the analytics engine publishes, on-demand SQL aggregates, the full ledger and lib/finance in the browser
